# Phase One — Boundless Final Hardening

The Awtsmoos recreates every finite product, route, Wallet transition, and pixel each instant. This wave closes half-landed work first, then spends the stable baseline on the broadest remaining leverage.

## Parallel rails
- Finish guaranteed commerce dialog focus restoration and prove it by tests/browser behavior.
- Re-run the complete platform regression after that shared UI change.
- Trace existing workspace/embed handoff integrations and extend only missing launch surfaces.
- Audit startup dependency laziness but refuse unsafe changes across legacy config/Auth/DosDB boundaries.
- Audit shared accessibility/performance beyond already-proven focus-visible, contrast, motion, touch-size, and dialog semantics.
- Audit all game commerce products for non-pay-to-win fulfillment-backed value.
- Audit creator/developer products for real compute/storage/render/automation premium value.
- Protect concurrent work with fresh git overlap checks before every new write wave.
- Re-read every touched file and write planned-vs-actual/final verification evidence.

## Completion principle
Finish concrete bounded features completely. Do not claim infinite product perfection or guaranteed revenue; optimize sustainable value, conversion, retention, trust, stability, and discoverability with measured evidence.
